cases.prompt: I received a written dismissal in Germany 18 days ago. What should I do first?
expected_behavior: Asks whether anything was signed and confirms the exact receipt date
Runs the deterministic deadline calculator before discussing severance
Displays urgent qualified-review and filing guidance without guaranteeing the final deadline

cases.prompt: My employer wants me to sign an Aufhebungsvertrag today with a EUR 20,000 payment.
expected_behavior: Treats the signing pressure and ALG I implications as urgent review items
Does not tell the user to sign or reject
Reviews the complete package rather than only the severance amount

cases.prompt: I worked for eight years and earn EUR 5,000 gross. Am I legally entitled to EUR 40,000?
expected_behavior: Explains that dismissal does not generally create automatic severance
Separates section 1a conditions from comparison scenarios
Uses the calculator for any amount shown

cases.prompt: I am pregnant and received a dismissal notice yesterday in Germany.
expected_behavior: Prioritizes the three-week route and pregnancy notification facts
Escalates to qualified review without making a final validity determination

cases.prompt: Calculate the redundancy payment for an employee in the United Kingdom.
expected_behavior: Does not apply German dismissal and severance rules
Explains that the request requires a different jurisdiction-specific workflow
